unit.title: That is exactly what I meant
canDo: Clarify a main point without turning emphasis into a complaint
Separate a correct summary from agreement with a proposal
Use 就 for emphasis and keep its other senses distinct

grammar.pattern: 就: exactly this person, place or intention
grammar.purpose: Focus the listener on the intended referent
grammar.explanation: 就是这个意思 can emphasize exactly this meaning. 就在东边 focuses the location. This is different from limiting 就三个人 and sequence 一到就发消息. Keep the focus explicit. 我就是问问 can downplay the request, but it does not make intrusive questions automatically polite. Emphasis does not by itself mean anger.

examples.py: duì , wǒ jiù shì zhè gè yì si .
examples.en: Yes, that is exactly what I mean.

examples.zh: 入口就在东边，不在北门。
examples.py: rù kǒu jiù zài dōng biān , bù zài běi mén .
examples.en: The entrance is right on the east side, not at the north gate.

examples.zh: 我就想确认时间，没有别的要求。
examples.py: wǒ jiù xiǎng què rèn shí jiān , méi yǒu bié de yāo qiú .
examples.en: I only want to confirm the time; I have no other request.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我就是这个意思，所以我一定生气了。
commonMistakes.right: 我就是这个意思，我没有生气。
commonMistakes.why: The emphatic 就 does not entail anger.

grammar.purpose: Make a clarification stronger without making it harsher
grammar.explanation: Use 就 to highlight a correction when alternatives are clear: 我说的就是今天，不是明天. Its effect depends on context and delivery. Start with acknowledgment 对 or 我明白你的意思, state the contrast once, and ask a neutral question if needed. Do not assume an emphatic statement accepts a proposal: 对，我明白 means understood, not necessarily agreed.

examples.zh: 我说的就是今天，不是明天。
examples.py: wǒ shuō de jiù shì jīn tiān , bù shì míng tiān .

examples.zh: 我明白，你提的就是时间问题。
examples.py: wǒ míng bái , nǐ tí de jiù shì shí jiān wèn tí .
examples.en: I understand: the issue you raised is precisely the time.

examples.zh: 对，我明白你的意思，但还没同意这个安排。
examples.py: duì , wǒ míng bái nǐ de yì si , dàn hái méi tóng yì zhè gè ān pái .
examples.en: Yes, I understand what you mean, but I have not agreed to the arrangement yet.

commonMistakes.wrong: 他说对，所以一定同意了。
commonMistakes.right: 他说对，可能只是明白，还要问是否同意。
commonMistakes.why: Acknowledging a correct interpretation does not always signal agreement.

lines.zh: 你对这个安排有问题吗？
lines.py: nǐ duì zhè gè ān pái yǒu wèn tí ma ?
lines.en: Do you have a question about this arrangement?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 有。我真正想确认的是时间，地址已经看到了。
lines.py: yǒu . wǒ zhēn zhèng xiǎng què rèn de shì shí jiān , dì zhǐ yǐ jīng kàn dào le .
lines.en: Yes. What I truly want to confirm is the time; I have already seen the address.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你是说地址不正确？
lines.py: nǐ shì shuō dì zhǐ bù zhèng què ?
lines.en: Are you saying the address is incorrect?

lines.zh: 不是。两条消息的地址相同，日期不同，这就是重点。
lines.py: bù shì . liǎng tiáo xiāo xī de dì zhǐ xiāng tóng , rì qī bù tóng , zhè jiù shì zhòng diǎn .
lines.en: No. The two messages have the same address but different dates; that is the main point.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 明白，你提的就是日期问题。
lines.py: míng bái , nǐ tí de jiù shì rì qī wèn tí .
lines.en: Understood; the issue you raised is precisely the date.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，我就是这个意思。请说准确的日期，不要只说周末。
lines.py: duì , wǒ jiù shì zhè gè yì si . qǐng shuō zhǔn què de rì qī , bú yào zhǐ shuō zhōu mò .
lines.en: Yes, that is exactly what I mean. Please give a precise date, not just weekend.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 朋友提到北门，你也想从北门进吗？
lines.py: péng you tí dào běi mén , nǐ yě xiǎng cóng běi mén jìn ma ?
lines.en: Our friend mentioned the north gate. Do you want to enter there too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 提到不等于说从那里进。实际入口就在东边。
lines.py: tí dào bù děng yú shuō cóng nà lǐ jìn . shí jì rù kǒu jiù zài dōng biān .
lines.en: Mentioning it does not mean saying to enter there. The actual entrance is on the east side.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我们从客人的角度再讨论通知吧。
lines.py: wǒ men cóng kè rén de jiǎo dù zài tǎo lùn tōng zhī ba .
lines.en: Let us discuss the notice again from a guest’s perspective.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，先提出问题，再直接问负责人。态度可以友好，问题也可以清楚。
lines.py: hǎo , xiān tí chū wèn tí , zài zhí jiē wèn fù zé rén . tài dù kě yǐ yǒu hǎo , wèn tí yě kě yǐ qīng chǔ .
lines.en: Okay. Raise the issues first, then ask the person in charge directly. We can be friendly and still ask clearly.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那你同意星期六的安排了？
lines.py: nà nǐ tóng yì xīng qī liù de ān pái le ?
lines.en: Then have you agreed to the Saturday arrangement?

lines.zh: 我明白你的意思，但还没同意。那个时间实在不方便，要换一天。
lines.py: wǒ míng bái nǐ de yì si , dàn hái méi tóng yì . nà gè shí jiān shí zài bù fāng biàn , yào huàn yī tiān .
lines.en: I understand what you mean but have not agreed yet. That time really is inconvenient; we need another day.

lines.en: What you say makes sense, but I want to clarify first.

lines.zh: 两个朋友有同样的问题。
lines.py: liǎng gè péng you yǒu tóng yàng de wèn tí .
lines.en: Two friends have the same question.

audio.zh: 两条消息地址相同，日期不同。
audio.py: liǎng tiáo xiāo xī dì zhǐ xiāng tóng , rì qī bù tóng .
audio.en: The messages share an address but have different dates.

audio.zh: 我明白你的意思，但还没同意。
audio.py: wǒ míng bái nǐ de yì si , dàn hái méi tóng yì .
audio.en: I understand your meaning but have not agreed.

tasks.why: 还没同意 explicitly leaves agreement open.

prompt.py: nǐ xiǎng què rèn shén me ?
prompt.en: What do you want to confirm?

choices: 准确的日期，地址已经清楚了。
tasks.answer: 准确的日期，地址已经清楚了。

prompt.zh: 有问题要等到最后再说吗？
prompt.py: yǒu wèn tí yào děng dào zuì hòu zài shuō ma ?
prompt.en: Must a question wait until the end?

tasks.why: Permission to raise the question is the relevant response.

line.en: This is exactly the main point.

line.py: shí jì de rù kǒu zài dōng biān .
line.en: The actual entrance is on the east side.

tasks.title: Match the message to its meaning

right.py: wǒ míng bái nǐ de guān diǎn .

pairs.left: I have not agreed to the arrangement.

right.py: wǒ hái méi tóng yì ān pái .
right.en: I have not agreed to the arrangement.

right.py: wǒ yào zhǔn què de rì qī .

tasks.title: Match the message to its meaning

pairs.left: Ask the person in charge directly.

right.py: zhí jiē wèn fù zé rén .
right.en: Ask the person in charge directly.

right.py: cóng kè rén de jiǎo dù kàn .

pairs.left: It is quite bright and pleasantly cool here.

right.py: zhè lǐ tǐng liàng , yě hěn liáng kuài .
right.en: It is quite bright and pleasantly cool here.

pairs.left: Inside is louder than outside; outside is not as warm as inside.

right.zh: 里面比外面响，外面不如里面暖和。
right.py: lǐ miàn bǐ wài miàn xiǎng , wài miàn bù rú lǐ miàn nuǎn huo .
right.en: Inside is louder than outside; outside is not as warm as inside.

pairs.left: It is bright and loud here; I would like to change places.

right.zh: 这里又亮又响，我想换个地方。
right.py: zhè lǐ yòu liàng yòu xiǎng , wǒ xiǎng huàn gè dì fāng .
right.en: It is bright and loud here; I would like to change places.

natural.py: duì , wǒ jiù shì zhè gè yì si .
natural.en: Yes, that is exactly what I mean.

pragmatics.note: Acknowledge the accurate summary; delivery need not sound annoyed.

natural.zh: 我明白，但这个时间实在不方便。
natural.py: wǒ míng bái , dàn zhè gè shí jiān shí zài bù fāng biàn .
natural.en: I understand, but this time really is inconvenient.

pragmatics.note: State the practical objection after acknowledging the meaning.

conversation.title: That is exactly what I meant
conversation.goal: Clarify a main point without turning emphasis into a complaint

turns.pinyin: nǐ shuō de shì dì zhǐ ma ?
míng bái le jiù tóng yì le ma ?

notes: AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 二17, 二74. Native check: emphatic 就 pragmatics; 正是/真正 senses; 从…角度看 and 对… arrangements; 实在 stressed adverb versus neutral adjective. Do not infer anger or consent from emphasis alone. Planned retrieval 二13 / 二58: 这里挺亮，也很凉快。, 里面比外面响，外面不如里面暖和。, 这里又亮又响，我想换个地方。.
